note: Small Alberta Parks recreation-area campground on open prairie at the Hwy 22 (Cowboy Trail) bridge over the Oldman River, 3 km west of Lundbreck and 27 km north: sites around two small gravel loops on the bank above the river, with a hand launch. Fishing on the Oldman; Bob Creek Wildland and the Black Creek Heritage Rangeland lie to the north. --Claude
